ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels and 20% low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central area with black pigmentation concentrated along the leading and trailing edges; approximately 20 discrete low-intensity circular blobs scattered bilaterally across the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-45 degree internal angle at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-frequency jagged serrations; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 10 to 30 pixels across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge lobes sweeping upward toward acute, distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine-line, low-intensity diagonal scratches visible on the mid-right lobe and lower-central region near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged trailing edge indicating significant physical wear or previous trauma; prominent dark circular scars likely from sessile organism attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy, high-frequency textured clusters on the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting dense barnacle colonization extending beyond the smooth skin boundary.
